changelog:
Initial public release of alibabacloud-network-diagnose.

- Provides a private network connectivity diagnosis tool for Alibaba Cloud VPC/ECS/NAT/CEN/VPN/Express Connect scenarios.
- Enforces strict first-step environment and input parsing using skill-provided scripts; blocks workflow until sufficient endpoint info is provided.
- Does not support diagnosis of classic network, public internet, DNS, CDN, SLB, or WAF issues.
- All diagnostic logic is handled through Python wrapper scripts; never inspects the agent runner/container environment.
- Requires Python 3.7+, aliyun CLI, and configured Alibaba Cloud credentials.
- Supports multi-fault investigation, enforcing bidirectional route checks, and session-based CLI user-agent tracking.
summary: [project] [user] Alibaba Cloud private network connectivity diagnosis tool. Use when ECS ping/telnet fails, same-VPC access fails, cross-VPC access fails, VPN or Express Connect is unreachable, NAT Gateway DNAT/SNAT behaves asymmetrically, or the user suspects security group, network ACL, route table, CEN/TR, VPC Peering, VPN Gateway, VBR, or NAT Gateway blocking. Not for classic network, public internet access, DNS resolution, CDN, SLB, or WAF issues.
